introduction.text: The Basilica di Santa Maria in Trastevere is a minor basilica and titular church in Rome, renowned for its early Christian heritage, medieval mosaics, and Baroque interior. It remains a key pilgrimage site and a living parish community.

history.description: In 38 BC a gush of oil from underground, known as fons olei, was reported by Dio Cassius and St. Jerome.
Pope Callixtus I founded a house‑church on the site around 220, as recorded in the Liber Pontificalis.
The original church on the site was probably built in the early fourth century, making it one of Rome's oldest churches dedicated to Mary.
Pope Julius I rebuilt the church on a larger scale in 340.
Under Pope Innocent II the church was re‑erected on its old foundations between 1140 and 1143.
In 1634 the icon of the Madonna di Strada Cupa was canonically crowned.
In 1659 the icon of Madonna della Clemenza was canonically crowned.
In 1887 Cardinal James Gibbons took possession of the titular church.
In 2014 the basilica hosted the wedding of Prince Amedeo of Belgium.
In 2018 Pope Francis celebrated a mass at the basilica to mark the 50th anniversary of the Community of Sant'Egidio.

design.description: The Romanesque campanile dates from the 12th century.
Carlo Fontana restored the façade in 1702, adding a balustrade with statues of four popes.
The 22 granite columns with Ionic and Corinthian capitals in the nave were taken from the Baths of Caracalla.
Domenichino painted the octagonal coffered ceiling in 1617, depicting the Assumption of the Virgin.
The basilica contains 12th‑ and late 13th‑century mosaics, including the Coronation of the Virgin (1130‑1143) and Life of the Virgin by Pietro Cavallini (1291).

art.description: The Madonna della Clemenza is a 6th‑ to 9th‑century encaustic panel painting, one of the five oldest Marian icons from the medieval period.
A 13th‑century mosaic of the Madonna and Child by Pietro Cavallini, located in a niche on the Romanesque campanile.
A 12th‑century mosaic of the Coronation of the Virgin, depicting Pope Innocent II holding a model of the church.
Mosaic series on the Life of the Virgin by Pietro Cavallini (1291) adorns the basilica.
